name: Not Working
overview: Scripture clearly contrasts diligence with idleness, showing that those who work faithfully, like the one who tills his land, will be satisfied and prosper, while the sluggard's desires go unfulfilled. The Proverbs emphasize that diligent labor leads to leadership and profit, whereas laziness results in poverty and subjugation. Though brief rest is natural, excessive slumber and folding of hands lead to lack. Yet, Luke reminds us that with God, even what seems impossible can be accomplished, encouraging believers to trust in His power alongside faithful work.
